'''Health and environment'''

**[[Slovenia]]'s [[15th Government of Slovenia|ruling cabinet]] approves a motion to recognize [[State of Palestine|Palestine]] as an independent nation and sends the motion to the [[National Assembly (Slovenia)|National Assembly]] for adoption. '''Law and crime'''
*[[Catalan independence movement]]
**The [[Cortes Generales|Spanish parliament]] votes to pass a bill granting [[amnesty]] to hundreds of [[Catalans|Catalan]] secessionists involved in the [[Catalan declaration of independence]] from 2011 to 2017. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/30/spain-passes-bill-granting-amnesty-to-catalan-separatists (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Prosecution of Donald Trump in New York]]
**Former [[President of the United States]] [[Donald Trump]] is found guilty by a [[jury]] on all 34 [[felony]] counts relating to [[Personal and business legal affairs of Donald Trump|falsifying business records]], becoming the first U.S. president to be convicted of a crime. [https://www.cnn.com/politics/live-news/trump-hush-money-trial-05-30-24/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Hong Kong]] convicts fourteen activists and politicians guilty of [[subversion]] under its [[2020 Hong Kong national security law|national security law]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/30/hong-kong-court-finds-14-of-16-democracy-activists-guilty-of-subversion (Al Jazeera)]
*The [[United States Department of Labor]] files a lawsuit against [[Hyundai Motors]] over illegal use of [[child labor]] at [[Hyundai Motor Manufacturing Alabama|the company's automobile factory]] in [[Montgomery, Alabama|Montgomery]], [[Alabama]], amid a nationwide [[Child labor in the United States#21st century|increase in child labor]] in the [[U.S.]] [https://www.reuters.com/business/autos-transportation/us-labor-department-sues-hyundai-over-us-child-labor-court-filing-2024-05-30/ (Reuters)]

*[[Footballer]] [[Gerard Piqué]] is placed under official investigation for his alleged involvement in [[Illicit financial flows|illegal payments]] in the relocation of the [[Supercopa de España]] from [[Spain]] to [[Saudi Arabia]].
